title: apricity-cli: apricity export --clips with --help, -o, --library, --force and located errors
description:
## Intent

The command a person runs.

## Scope

- `--clips <path>...` mode of `apricity export` (crates/apricity-cli/src/export.rs): one or more samples or folders; `-o <folder>` (default: `./clips`); `--library <dir>`; `--force`; plus the kinds flag only if the owner included holds and phrases (`--kinds sections,loops,shots,holds,phrases`, default the owner's choice).
- `--help`: flags, the naming rule in one line, an example.
- Errors printed as in the story, all of them, exit non-zero if any sample failed; a summary line per sample: `Thunderer: 2 sections, 4 loops, 12 shots`.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test export_cli
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test conformance
```
All M3 scenarios green; `apricity export --help` in a comment.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): apricity export --clips`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the folder writer task. Shares `Cmd::Export` with M1 and the set export.
